font.reason: Markazi Text rendered monoline and sans-like and too light against the heavy Georgia lockup. Amiri is a real high-contrast Naskh serif, and a 2.5px ink text stroke restores the heavy weight, since Amiri has only one weight. Vazir Code stays for the console kicker.

comps.translatedSummary: Wordmark «آزمایشگاه هوش مصنوعی», kicker «کنسول پژوهشی تیم».

rtlDecisions.why: Markazi to Amiri with a 2.5px stroke to restore the heavy serif lockup. Motion and timing are unchanged.
Bottom moved from -6 to 14 so it sits just under the Persian descenders. The 1.3 line-height had left it floating.

rtlDecisions.what: Cascade, kicker typewriter and cursor, crosshair
